typography.heading_treatment: Manrope at bold to extrabold weights (700–800), tight letter-spacing (-0.02em to -0.03em), and a compact modular scale — large display headings for heroes and page headers, stepping down cleanly through H2–H4 for section and card titles. Conveys modern clarity and quiet confidence.
typography.body_treatment: Source Sans 3 at regular weight (400), with a comfortable line-height of 1.65–1.75 and a line length capped around 68 characters. Used for all paragraph copy, FAQs, article text, and form labels — warm and highly legible across all contexts.
typography.accent_treatment: DM Sans at medium weight (500), set in small uppercase with wide letter-spacing (0.08em–0.12em) for eyebrow labels, stat captions, module category tags, and practitioner credential lines. Adds structural rhythm to the bento grid without visual heaviness.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Clearmind Therapy Home page is a classic stacked landing layout rendered through a bento modular lens — every section uses rounded, card-based modules, asymmetric grid arrangements, and a disciplined color system to create warmth without clinical coldness. The overall page background is Clearmind Cloud (#F5F7FA), which acts as the continuous canvas tying all sections together. Individual bento modules alternate between Clearmind White (#FFFFFF) for elevated card surfaces, Clearmind Mist (#E8EEF4) for secondary panels, and Clearmind Dew (#D6F0E8) for accent-tinted highlight tiles. Clearmind Slate (#1A2332) anchors all primary headings and navigation. Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C) is the single bright accent — used exclusively for primary CTAs, active underlines, icon fills, and key stat highlights to maintain visual focus. Clearmind Stone (#6B7A8F) handles all secondary text, captions, eyebrow labels, and meta copy. Clearmind Coral (#E8715A) appears only as a rare warmth accent — perhaps a single decorative dot or a subtle badge in the testimonial section.

Typography follows the shared system strictly: Manrope 700–800 for all headings with tight letter-spacing (-0.02em), Source Sans 3 400 at 1.7 line-height for all body and description copy, and DM Sans 500 in small uppercase with 0.10em letter-spacing for all eyebrow labels and stat captions. The heading scale steps down cleanly from a large display size in the hero (clamp 48–72px) through H2 section headers (36–48px) to H3 card titles (20–24px).

Section rhythm is deliberately varied to prevent monotony: the hero is full-width and visually generous with a split layout; the stats section is compact and horizontally dense; the feature grid opens into an asymmetric bento arrangement; the testimonial section returns to a three-column card rhythm; and the closing CTA is bold and centered. Vertical spacing between sections uses consistent padding (80–100px top/bottom on desktop, 56px on tablet, 40px on mobile) with no section bleeding into the next — each section is visually self-contained but connected by the shared Cloud background.

On desktop (≥1280px), the layout uses a 12-column grid at 1200px max-width with 24px gutters. On tablet (768–1279px), it collapses to 8 columns with card grids moving to 2-column arrangements. On mobile (≤767px), everything stacks to a single column with full-width cards, reduced heading sizes, and vertically stacked CTAs. Bento modules maintain their rounded-corner radius (16px on large cards, 12px on smaller tiles) at all breakpoints. No section uses a full-bleed dark background except the closing CTA, which uses Clearmind Slate as its background surface for maximum contrast and visual weight as the page's final statement.

section_design_plans.nl_prompt: Design a split-layout hero section on a Clearmind Cloud (#F5F7FA) background with a maximum width of 1200px centered on the page and 100px vertical padding top and bottom. The left column (roughly 55% width on desktop) contains all text content stacked vertically with generous spacing. Begin with the eyebrow label 'Mental Health Therapy' rendered in DM Sans 500, uppercase, 11px, 0.10em letter-spacing, Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C) color, with a 2px Sage left-border accent or a small Sage pill badge. Below it, place the headline 'You deserve a space that feels like yours.' in Manrope 800, approximately 60px on desktop (clamp to 36px on mobile), Clearmind Slate (#1A2332), tight letter-spacing (-0.03em), line-height 1.15, spanning no more than 10 words per line for impact. Below the headline, render the subheadline 'Clearmind Therapy connects you with licensed therapists who meet you where you are — and help you move forward.' in Source Sans 3 400, 18px, Clearmind Stone (#6B7A8F), line-height 1.7, capped at 52 characters per line. Below the subheadline, place two CTA buttons side by side with 16px gap: the primary button 'Find Your Therapist' uses a solid Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C) fill with Clearmind White text in DM Sans 500 14px uppercase, 8px vertical padding, 24px horizontal padding, 10px border-radius, and a subtle hover darkening; the secondary button 'Explore Our Services' uses a transparent fill with a 1.5px Clearmind Slate border and Clearmind Slate text, same sizing, with a hover fill of Clearmind Mist. On the right column (45% width), position the illustration asset: a calm, modular bento-style arrangement of soft geometric shapes — overlapping rounded rectangles in Clearmind Dew (#D6F0E8), Clearmind Mist (#E8EEF4), and Clearmind White — suggesting an open window, a potted plant silhouette, and a comfortable chair without literal depiction. The illustration is contained within a large rounded rectangle module (24px radius) in Clearmind White with a soft box-shadow (0 4px 24px rgba(26,35,50,0.07)) that floats slightly above the background. The illustration fills the right column from roughly 40px below the nav to the bottom of the section. On tablet, the layout shifts to stacked: illustration moves above the text block, constrained to 400px max-height. On mobile, the illustration is hidden or reduced to a decorative top banner strip at 120px height to preserve reading space.

Design a compact, horizontally dense stats section that sits directly below the hero with 80px vertical padding. The section background is Clearmind Mist (#E8EEF4) — a subtle panel shift from the Cloud background that signals a new content zone without harsh contrast. At the top center, render the eyebrow label 'Our Practice at a Glance' in DM Sans 500, 11px uppercase, 0.10em letter-spacing, Clearmind Stone (#6B7A8F). Below it, render the headline 'Thousands of sessions. One goal: your wellbeing.' in Manrope 700, 36px, Clearmind Slate (#1A2332), centered, letter-spacing -0.02em, with a max-width of 560px centered on the page. Below the headline, arrange the four stat items in a single horizontal row on desktop using a 4-column bento grid with 16px gaps. Each stat tile is a rounded rectangle (16px radius) in Clearmind White (#FFFFFF) with a soft box-shadow (0 2px 12px rgba(26,35,50,0.06)), 32px internal padding, and a minimum height of 140px. Within each tile: the stat value ('12+', '4,800+', '96%', 'Same-week') is set in Manrope 800, 40px, Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C), centered; below it, the description text ('Licensed therapists across specialties', etc.) is set in Source Sans 3 400, 14px, Clearmind Stone (#6B7A8F), centered, line-height 1.6. The 'Same-week' tile uses a Clearmind Dew (#D6F0E8) background fill instead of White to visually distinguish the availability stat as a warm highlight. On tablet, the four tiles wrap to a 2×2 grid. On mobile, they stack to a single column at full width, each tile reduced to 24px internal padding.

Design an asymmetric bento feature grid section on the Clearmind Cloud (#F5F7FA) background with 100px vertical padding. At the top of the section, left-aligned within the 1200px container, render the eyebrow label 'Why Clearmind' in DM Sans 500, 11px uppercase, 0.10em letter-spacing, Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C). Below it, render the headline 'Therapy that fits your life — not the other way around.' in Manrope 800, 44px, Clearmind Slate (#1A2332), letter-spacing -0.02em, left-aligned, max-width 600px. Below the headline, render the subheadline 'We built our practice around you: your schedule, your pace, your goals.' in Source Sans 3 400, 17px, Clearmind Stone (#6B7A8F), left-aligned, max-width 520px, line-height 1.7. Below the text header block (32px gap), render the four feature items in an asymmetric bento grid layout: on desktop, use a 2-column layout where the left column is wider (roughly 58%) containing two stacked tiles, and the right column (42%) contains one tall tile and one shorter tile, all with 16px gaps. Each feature tile is a rounded rectangle (16px radius) with 32px internal padding. Tile 1 ('Evidence-Based Methods') uses Clearmind White background, is standard height (~180px), has a small Sage-colored icon placeholder (24px square, top-left of content), the title in Manrope 700 18px Slate, and description in Source Sans 3 400 15px Stone. Tile 2 ('In-Person & Telehealth') uses Clearmind Dew (#D6F0E8) background, same sizing and treatment. Tile 3 ('Diverse Specialties') spans the full height of the right column (tall tile, ~376px), uses Clearmind Slate (#1A2332) as its background, with the title in Manrope 700 20px Clearmind White, description in Source Sans 3 400 15px rgba(255,255,255,0.75), and a large decorative Sage-tinted abstract shape (soft circle or arc) as a background element at low opacity (0.12) to add depth. Tile 4 ('No Waitlist Pressure') uses Clearmind Mist background, standard height, same text treatment as Tiles 1–2. All tiles have box-shadow (0 2px 16px rgba(26,35,50,0.06)). Below the grid, left-align the CTA 'See All Services' as a text link with a Sage underline and right-pointing arrow in Manrope 600 15px Sage, with a hover state that shifts to Slate. On tablet, collapse to a 2-column equal grid. On mobile, stack all four tiles to single column full-width.

Design a testimonial section with 100px vertical padding on a Clearmind Cloud (#F5F7FA) background. At the top center, render the eyebrow label 'Client Stories' in DM Sans 500, 11px uppercase, 0.10em letter-spacing, Clearmind Stone (#6B7A8F). Below it, render the headline 'Healing happens here.' in Manrope 800, 44px, Clearmind Slate (#1A2332), centered, letter-spacing -0.02em. Below the headline, render the subheadline 'Hear from people who took the first step — and kept going.' in Source Sans 3 400, 17px, Clearmind Stone (#6B7A8F), centered, max-width 480px, line-height 1.7. Below the header block (40px gap), arrange three testimonial cards in a horizontal 3-column row with 20px gaps. Each card is a rounded rectangle (16px radius) with 36px internal padding and a minimum height of 220px. Card 1 ('I finally feel understood.') uses Clearmind White (#FFFFFF) background with a box-shadow (0 4px 20px rgba(26,35,50,0.08)); at the top-left of the card, place a large opening quotation mark in Manrope 800, 48px, Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C) at 0.3 opacity as a decorative element; the quote title in Manrope 700 18px Clearmind Slate; the description body in Source Sans 3 400 15px Clearmind Stone, line-height 1.7; and the attribution line at the bottom in DM Sans 500 12px uppercase 0.08em letter-spacing Clearmind Stone. Card 2 ('Our relationship is stronger than ever.') uses Clearmind Dew (#D6F0E8) as its background fill — slightly elevated visual treatment to feature the couples story — with a small Clearmind Coral (#E8715A) dot (8px circle) as a warm accent in the top-right corner of the card; same typographic treatment. Card 3 ('I didn't know how much I needed this.') uses Clearmind White background, same treatment as Card 1. All three cards align to the same top edge. On tablet, collapse to a 2-column grid with the third card centered below at reduced width. On mobile, stack all three cards to a single column full-width with 16px vertical gaps.

Design a bold, centered closing CTA section using Clearmind Slate (#1A2332) as the full-width section background, with 100px vertical padding, creating a strong visual contrast that signals the page's final call to action. Behind all content, place the bento-grid pattern asset: a subtle repeating field of small rounded rectangles (approximately 40×18px each, 8px radius) arranged in a loose offset grid at varying opacities (0.04–0.08) in Clearmind White, covering the entire section background as a low-contrast texture that adds depth without competing with the text. All pattern elements are non-interactive decorative only. Centered within the 1200px container, render the eyebrow label 'Ready When You Are' in DM Sans 500, 11px uppercase, 0.10em letter-spacing, Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C). Below it, render the headline 'Your first session starts with a single conversation.' in Manrope 800, 48px, Clearmind White (#FFFFFF), centered, letter-spacing -0.02em, max-width 640px, line-height 1.2. Below the headline (20px gap), render the subheadline 'No commitment required. Just a free 15-minute call to find the right fit.' in Source Sans 3 400, 18px, rgba(255,255,255,0.72), centered, max-width 480px, line-height 1.7. Below the subheadline (36px gap), place two CTA buttons centered and side by side with 16px gap: the primary button 'Book a Free Consultation' uses a solid Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C) fill with Clearmind White text in DM Sans 500 14px uppercase, 12px vertical padding, 28px horizontal padding, 10px border-radius, with a hover state that lightens the Sage fill slightly; the secondary button 'Read Our Resources' uses a transparent fill with a 1.5px Clearmind White border and Clearmind White text, same sizing, with a hover fill of rgba(255,255,255,0.10). On mobile, stack the two buttons to full-width single column with 12px vertical gap between them. The section has no top or bottom border — the Slate background itself acts as the visual boundary, creating a clean hard edge against the Cloud sections above and the footer below.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Services page follows a classic stacked landing layout rendered through the Bento Modular aesthetic — every section is composed of rounded, card-like modules with clear internal padding, consistent corner radii (16–24px), and deliberate whitespace between each vertical block. The page background is Clearmind Cloud (#F5F7FA) throughout, establishing an airy, clinical-calm canvas. Individual sections alternate between Cloud and White (#FFFFFF) surface treatments to create gentle visual rhythm without hard dividers. The single bright accent — Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C) — is reserved exclusively for CTAs, active highlights, icon fills, and key interactive states. Clearmind Mist (#E8EEF4) fills secondary card surfaces and comparison panels. Clearmind Dew (#D6F0E8) is used for stat or feature tile tints and the CTA section's background wash. Clearmind Slate (#1A2332) anchors all primary headings and navigation. Clearmind Stone (#6B7A8F) handles all supporting copy, captions, metadata labels, and eyebrow tags.

Typography follows the shared system strictly: Manrope 700–800 at tight letter-spacing for all H1–H3 headings; Source Sans 3 400 at 1.65–1.75 line-height for body and description copy; DM Sans 500 in small uppercase with 0.10em letter-spacing for all eyebrow labels, metadata tags, and category lines. The modular scale steps down cleanly — the page header uses the largest display size, section headlines use H2, card titles use H3, and metadata/eyebrow lines use the DM Sans accent treatment.

Section rhythm: The page opens with a compact, centered page header (section 1), followed by the densest and most visually complex section — the six-card service grid (section 2). Section 3 is a focused two-column comparison panel with a lighter surface. Section 4 is a full-width FAQ accordion-style module. Section 5 is the closing CTA band with a Dew-tinted background and illustration. Vertical spacing between sections is generous (80–100px on desktop, 48–64px on mobile) to let each bento cluster breathe. All sections are horizontally constrained to a max-width of 1200px, centered, with 24px horizontal padding on mobile and 48px on tablet.

Responsive behavior: On desktop, the service grid is a 3-column asymmetric bento layout. On tablet it collapses to 2 columns. On mobile it becomes a single-column stacked list. The comparison section is 2 columns on desktop/tablet and stacks vertically on mobile. The FAQ accordion is always full-width. The CTA section is centered single-column on all breakpoints. All bento cards maintain their rounded corners and internal padding at every breakpoint — the modular identity is preserved across screen sizes. Interactive states (hover on cards, focus on FAQ items) use a subtle Sage border or shadow lift to signal interactivity without disrupting the calm palette. No decorative gradients are used — all depth is achieved through surface color contrast, box shadows (soft, low-opacity Slate), and whitespace.

section_design_plans.nl_prompt:
Design a compact, centered page header section for the Services page. The section sits at the very top of the content area, directly below the site navigation, on a Clearmind Cloud (#F5F7FA) background. There is no full-bleed hero image — instead, the content is typographically driven and intentionally restrained, signaling clarity and calm. Vertical padding is 72px top, 56px bottom on desktop; 48px top, 40px bottom on mobile.

Layout: All content is horizontally centered, max-width 680px, within the 1200px page container.

Eyebrow: 'What We Offer' rendered in DM Sans 500, uppercase, 0.10em letter-spacing, 12px font size, Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C) color. Positioned above the headline with 0 bottom margin before a 12px gap to the headline.

Headline: 'Therapy shaped around you.' in Manrope 800, ~52px on desktop / 36px on mobile, Clearmind Slate (#1A2332), letter-spacing -0.03em. This is the largest typographic moment on the page — it should feel grounded and personal, not clinical.

Subheadline: 'Whether you're navigating anxiety, relationship strain, or a major life change, we have a path forward designed for your situation.' in Source Sans 3 400, 19px on desktop / 17px on mobile, Clearmind Stone (#6B7A8F), line-height 1.7, max-width 580px centered. Sits 20px below the headline.

No CTAs, no images, no cards in this section. The section serves purely as a reassuring orienting moment. A subtle 1px Clearmind Mist (#E8EEF4) horizontal rule below the section separates it from the service grid — do not use a hard divider, just a faint line or 8px section gap accent.

Design the primary service grid section — the most visually complex and information-dense section on the page. This is the heart of the Services page and must embody the Bento Modular aesthetic at its fullest. The section background is Clearmind White (#FFFFFF), with 80px vertical padding on desktop and 56px on mobile.

Section header (centered, max-width 720px, centered in the 1200px container):
- Eyebrow: 'Our Services' in DM Sans 500, uppercase, 0.10em letter-spacing, 12px, Clearmind Stone (#6B7A8F).
- Headline: 'Find the support that fits your life.' in Manrope 700, 40px desktop / 28px mobile, Clearmind Slate (#1A2332), letter-spacing -0.02em.
- 32px gap below the headline before the card grid begins.

Card Grid Layout: Six service cards arranged in an asymmetric 3-column bento grid on desktop. The top row contains three equal-width cards. The bottom row also contains three equal-width cards. Each card is a rounded rectangle (20px border-radius), background Clearmind Mist (#E8EEF4), with 28px internal padding. Cards have a soft box-shadow (0 2px 12px rgba(26,35,50,0.07)) and on hover elevate slightly (0 6px 24px rgba(26,35,50,0.12)) with a 1.5px Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C) border appearing — this signals interactivity.

Each card contains, from top to bottom:
1. Icon: A minimal line icon (from the six-icon set described in the asset ideas — single person, two interlinked figures, family group, teen silhouette, video screen, medical clipboard respectively). Icon is 32×32px, Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C) stroke color, placed in the top-left of the card. Do not center the icon — left-align it for a dashboard-widget feel.
2. Service title: Manrope 700, 20px, Clearmind Slate (#1A2332), 12px below the icon.
3. Description: Source Sans 3 400, 15px, Clearmind Stone (#6B7A8F), line-height 1.65, 10px below the title.
4. Metadata row: Two small pill-shaped tags at the bottom of the card — one for session length, one for format. Each pill: DM Sans 500, 11px, uppercase, 0.08em letter-spacing, Clearmind Dew (#D6F0E8) background, Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C) text, 4px vertical / 10px horizontal padding, 20px border-radius. The pills sit 16px below the description, flush to the bottom of the card.

On tablet: 2-column grid, cards reflow naturally, maintaining equal widths.
On mobile: Single-column stacked list, full-width cards.

Below the card grid, centered, 40px below the last card row: A single primary CTA button — 'Book a Consultation' — in Manrope 700, 16px, Clearmind White (#FFFFFF) text on Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C) background, 14px vertical / 32px horizontal padding, 10px border-radius. On hover: background darkens 10% toward #3A9E7C. The button is the only Sage-filled element in this section, making it visually dominant as the action anchor.

Design a focused two-panel comparison section helping visitors choose between in-person and telehealth therapy. The section background is Clearmind Cloud (#F5F7FA), 72px vertical padding on desktop, 48px on mobile. This section should feel calm and informative — not a hard sales push, but a helpful decision tool.

Section header (centered, max-width 640px):
- Eyebrow: 'In-Person vs. Telehealth' in DM Sans 500, uppercase, 0.10em letter-spacing, 12px, Clearmind Stone (#6B7A8F).
- Headline: 'Both paths lead to real progress.' in Manrope 700, 36px desktop / 26px mobile, Clearmind Slate (#1A2332), letter-spacing -0.02em.
- Subheadline: 'Here's how to decide what works best for you.' in Source Sans 3 400, 18px, Clearmind Stone (#6B7A8F), line-height 1.7. 16px below headline.
- 40px gap below subheadline before the comparison panels.

Comparison panels: Two side-by-side bento cards on desktop (equal width, 24px gap between), stacking vertically on mobile. Each panel is a rounded rectangle (20px border-radius), 32px internal padding.

Left panel — 'In-Person Therapy': Background Clearmind White (#FFFFFF). A subtle left-border accent: 3px solid Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C). Title in Manrope 700, 22px, Clearmind Slate (#1A2332). Description in Source Sans 3 400, 16px, Clearmind Stone (#6B7A8F), line-height 1.7, 12px below title. Metadata block at the bottom of the card: two rows, each with a DM Sans 500 uppercase label (12px, Clearmind Stone) and a value in Source Sans 3 400, 15px, Clearmind Slate. Label: 'Availability' / Value: 'Mon–Sat'. Label: 'Location' / Value: 'Our downtown office suite'. Metadata sits 20px below the description, separated by a 1px Clearmind Mist (#E8EEF4) horizontal rule.

Right panel — 'Telehealth Therapy': Background Clearmind Dew (#D6F0E8). Same typographic structure as the left panel. The Dew background differentiates the telehealth option as a warm, accessible alternative without implying it is lesser. Same left-border accent in Sage. Same metadata structure: 'Availability' / 'Mon–Sun', 'Location' / 'Anywhere with a secure connection'.

No CTAs in this section. The section ends with 72px bottom padding before transitioning to the FAQ section. On desktop, both panels are equal in height (CSS grid stretch), so they always align vertically regardless of content length.

Design a full-width FAQ section that feels warm, open, and low-pressure — designed to dissolve the hesitation of first-time therapy seekers. The section background is Clearmind White (#FFFFFF), 80px vertical padding on desktop, 56px on mobile.

Section header (left-aligned within the content container, max-width 1200px, 48px horizontal padding):
- Eyebrow: 'Common Questions' in DM Sans 500, uppercase, 0.10em letter-spacing, 12px, Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C).
- Headline: 'Answers before you even have to ask.' in Manrope 700, 38px desktop / 26px mobile, Clearmind Slate (#1A2332), letter-spacing -0.02em.
- 36px gap below headline before the FAQ list begins.

FAQ layout: A single-column accordion-style list, max-width 760px, left-aligned (not centered) within the content container on desktop — this creates a deliberate asymmetry consistent with the bento aesthetic, leaving negative space on the right. On mobile, full-width.

Each FAQ item is a bento module: a rounded rectangle (14px border-radius), background Clearmind Cloud (#F5F7FA), 20px vertical / 24px horizontal internal padding, 10px gap between items. Each item contains:
1. Question title: Manrope 700, 17px, Clearmind Slate (#1A2332), displayed as the always-visible row. A small chevron icon (right-aligned, Clearmind Stone, 16px) indicates expand/collapse state.
2. Answer body: Source Sans 3 400, 16px, Clearmind Stone (#6B7A8F), line-height 1.7. Revealed below the question title on expansion with a smooth 200ms ease transition. 12px padding-top before the answer text.

The first FAQ item ('Do you accept insurance?') is shown in its expanded state by default to signal that the accordion is interactive. Its expanded state: background Clearmind White (#FFFFFF) with a 1.5px Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C) border, chevron rotated 180°.

All five FAQ items are present: insurance, service selection, therapist fit, therapy duration, and confidentiality.

Below the FAQ list, 32px below the last item: A text-link CTA — 'Still have questions? Contact us' — in DM Sans 500, 15px, Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C), underlined on hover, with a small right-arrow glyph inline. This is a low-commitment secondary action, not a button.

Design the closing CTA section — a warm, conversion-focused band that invites visitors to take the first step toward booking. The section background is a solid Clearmind Dew (#D6F0E8) fill — a soft, sage-tinted wash that signals warmth and forward motion without being loud. 96px vertical padding on desktop, 64px on mobile.

Layout: The section is split into two columns on desktop (60/40 split), stacking vertically on mobile. Left column holds all copy and CTAs. Right column holds the illustration asset, right-aligned within its column.

Left column content (vertically centered within the section):
- Eyebrow: 'Take the First Step' in DM Sans 500, uppercase, 0.10em letter-spacing, 12px, Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C).
- Headline: 'The right support is closer than you think.' in Manrope 800, 44px desktop / 30px mobile, Clearmind Slate (#1A2332), letter-spacing -0.03em, max-width 480px.
- Subheadline: 'Book a free 15-minute call and let us find the right fit for you.' in Source Sans 3 400, 18px, Clearmind Stone (#6B7A8F), line-height 1.7, 16px below headline, max-width 420px.
- CTA button row, 28px below subheadline: Two buttons side by side (stacking vertically on mobile with 12px gap).
  - Primary: 'Schedule a Free Call' — Manrope 700, 16px, Clearmind White (#FFFFFF) text on Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C) background, 14px vertical / 32px horizontal padding, 10px border-radius. Hover: darkens to #3A9E7C.
  - Secondary: 'Meet Our Practitioners' — Manrope 700, 16px, Clearmind Slate (#1A2332) text, transparent background, 1.5px Clearmind Slate border, same padding and radius. Hover: background fills with Clearmind Mist (#E8EEF4).

Right column — Illustration asset: The abstract modular grid illustration (stepping stones / connected bento blocks leading toward an open horizon) is placed flush right within its column, vertically centered. The illustration should be approximately 340px wide on desktop, scaling down proportionally on tablet. On mobile, the illustration is hidden (display:none) to keep the CTA focused and uncluttered. The illustration uses the Clearmind palette — Sage, Mist, and Dew shapes — so it integrates seamlessly with the Dew background without appearing as a foreign element. No drop shadow on the illustration; it sits flat against the Dew background.

The section has no top or bottom border — it transitions from the FAQ's White background to Dew naturally, and the page ends after this section (before the site footer). The footer sits directly below on the same Cloud background as the rest of the site.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Practitioners page is the emotional core of the Clearmind Therapy site — it must feel personal, trustworthy, and organized without being clinical. The overall page uses Clearmind Cloud (#F5F7FA) as the base background, with sections alternating between Cloud and Clearmind Mist (#E8EEF4) to create gentle visual rhythm and section separation without hard dividers. The bento modular aesthetic governs every section: content lives in rounded-corner modules (16–20px border radius), cards have clear elevation via white fills against mist or cloud backgrounds, and the grid is asymmetric and intentional rather than a simple uniform matrix.

Typography follows the shared system strictly: Manrope at 700–800 weight for all headlines with tight letter-spacing (-0.02em), Source Sans 3 at 400 weight for all body and descriptor copy, and DM Sans at 500 weight in small uppercase with wide tracking (0.10em) for all eyebrow labels and metadata tags. The modular scale steps down cleanly — display-scale headlines only in the hero/page header, H2 for section headlines, H3 for card titles, and small body for metadata and captions.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Resources page functions as Clearmind Therapy's editorial hub — a calm, authoritative, and genuinely useful destination that feels more like a trusted clinical library than a marketing page. The overall tone is warm-intellectual: organized and modern through the bento-modular aesthetic, yet human and approachable through the brand voice.

**Page Color Strategy:** The page background is Clearmind Cloud (#F5F7FA) throughout, providing a clean, airy reading environment. Bento card surfaces alternate between Clearmind White (#FFFFFF) and Clearmind Mist (#E8EEF4) to create visual rhythm without noise. Clearmind Dew (#D6F0E8) is used as a soft tint on feature category tiles and the story block panel. Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C) appears on category tags, read-time badges, interactive hover states, CTA buttons, and key accent elements. Clearmind Slate (#1A2332) anchors all primary headings and navigation. Clearmind Stone (#6B7A8F) handles all secondary text, metadata, captions, and supporting copy. Clearmind Coral (#E8715A) is used sparingly — only on the crisis support resource tile — to signal urgency and warmth appropriately.

**Typography Rhythm:** All section eyebrows use DM Sans medium (500), uppercase, wide letter-spacing (0.10em), in Clearmind Stone. Section headlines use Manrope extrabold (800), tight letter-spacing (-0.025em), in Clearmind Slate. Subheadlines use Manrope regular-to-semibold (400–600) in Clearmind Stone. Article titles within cards use Manrope bold (700) in Clearmind Slate. Body copy and article descriptions use Source Sans 3 regular (400), line-height 1.70, in Clearmind Stone or Slate depending on surface.

**Layout Family — Classic Landing:** The page stacks vertically in this order: page header → featured article list → resource library grid → clinical team story block → closing CTA. Sections are separated by generous vertical spacing (80–100px on desktop, 56–64px on mobile) to allow the editorial content to breathe. No horizontal rules or hard dividers — section rhythm is managed through background color shifts and spacing alone.

**Bento Modular Aesthetic:** The article list section uses an asymmetric bento card grid (not a uniform table), with cards of varying visual weight — a hero-sized featured card at top-left and smaller supporting cards filling the remaining grid. The resource library section uses a 2×2 bento grid of rounded feature tiles with icons. The story block uses a single wide editorial panel. This creates a dashboard-like rhythm without feeling cold or corporate.

**Density:** Medium-high editorial density in the article list, balanced by generous padding within each card. The feature grid and story block sections are lower density — more breathing room, larger type, more whitespace. The CTA section is the lightest of all — minimal, focused, conversion-oriented.

**Responsive Behavior:** On desktop (1280px+), the article list bento grid is a 3-column layout with a spanning hero card. On tablet (768–1279px), it collapses to a 2-column grid. On mobile (<768px), all grids become single-column stacks. The resource library grid is 2×2 on desktop/tablet, single-column on mobile. Navigation remains fixed at top. All card padding scales down proportionally on smaller viewports.

**Cross-Page Fit:** The Resources page shares the same top navigation and footer as all other pages. It is the most content-dense page in the site, sitting between the Practitioners detail page and the Contact page. It should feel like a natural editorial pause before the final conversion push on Contact — educational, generous, trust-building. The closing CTA section bridges directly to the Contact page's booking flow.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Contact page is the emotional and functional culmination of the Clearmind Therapy site — it must feel like a soft landing, not a bureaucratic endpoint. The overarching visual tone is calm, spacious, and human. Every design decision should reinforce that reaching out is safe, easy, and low-stakes.

**Page-level color strategy:** The page opens on a Clearmind Cloud (#F5F7FA) background that transitions into alternating Clearmind Mist (#E8EEF4) and White (#FFFFFF) section panels, creating a gentle vertical rhythm without jarring contrast. The Clearmind Sage (#4AAE8C) accent is used purposefully — on the primary CTA button, active form field borders, and small iconographic elements — never decoratively overused. Clearmind Dew (#D6F0E8) appears as soft fill tints on the contact info tiles and FAQ module backgrounds. Clearmind Slate (#1A2332) anchors all headings and navigation. Clearmind Stone (#6B7A8F) handles all secondary copy, labels, and captions. Coral (#E8715A) is reserved only for form validation errors and is not used decoratively on this page.

**Typography rhythm:** All section eyebrows use DM Sans medium, small uppercase, wide letter-spacing (0.10em), in Clearmind Stone — providing structural anchoring without visual weight. Section headlines use Manrope 700–800, tight letter-spacing (-0.02em), in Clearmind Slate, scaled down from the hero display size used on the Home page — this is a working page, so display sizing is restrained. Body copy and form labels use Source Sans 3 at 400 weight, line-height 1.7, capped at 68 characters per line.

**Layout family — Classic Landing applied to Contact:** The page stacks vertically in a clear top-to-bottom sequence: page header → primary contact form → map/location block → contact info grid → FAQ. This linear flow mirrors the emotional journey of a first-time visitor: welcome → take action → know where we are → other ways to reach us → last questions answered. No section competes with another; each has a clear job.

**Bento modular aesthetic on a contact page:** The bento aesthetic is expressed through the contact form's layout (form fields arranged in a two-column bento-style grid on desktop, collapsing to single column on mobile), the contact info tiles (four rounded bento cards in a 2×2 grid), and the FAQ accordion modules (each styled as a distinct rounded card). The map section uses a large rounded-corner illustrated map tile as the hero visual, paired with address copy in a sidebar panel — a classic bento split composition.

**Density and spacing:** This page is deliberately lower-density than the Services or Practitioners pages. Generous vertical padding (80–100px between sections on desktop, 56–64px on mobile) ensures nothing feels rushed. The contact form section is the most prominent and receives the most breathing room. White space is a design element here — it communicates safety and calm.

**Responsive behavior:** On desktop (1280px+), sections use a max-width container of 1120px centered. The contact form section uses a 60/40 split layout (form left, reassurance copy and trust signals right). The map section uses a 55/45 split (map tile left, address info right). The contact info grid is 4 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile. The FAQ section is single-column on all breakpoints, with each item as a full-width expandable card. On mobile, all multi-column layouts collapse gracefully to single-column stacks, with the form taking full width and each field stacking vertically.

**Navigation and footer:** The sticky top navigation follows the shared design system — Clearmind Slate background, White nav links, Sage CTA button. The Contact page CTA in the nav is highlighted as active. The footer is standard, consistent with all other pages.

**Cross-page rhythm:** This page is the quietest and most intimate of the five. It deliberately uses less visual complexity than the Home or Practitioners pages — fewer decorative elements, no large photography, softer module fills — so the visitor's attention stays on the form and the message: "We're here. This is easy. You're safe."

- CTA button: 'Back to Practitioners' — positioned below the illustration with 24px gap. Outlined style: 1px border Clearmind Sage, Sage text, White background, border-radius 8px, height 44px, Manrope 600, 14px. Hover: Sage background, White text. Left-aligned within the right column.
